subject: Re: M-layer kickoff — matrix exponentiation as a drop-in layer
body:
Anders,

Staffing and compute picture for the plan you laid out.

Staffing: Farah and Oyin at 50% each through April for the API + Evalline work. Umar at 40% for the robustness study. Fumiko Rossi is committed at 60%+ to this project for June 2026 — she'll drive the adversarial sweep and the periodicity demo through the final push to 06-22. I've written that into our June allocation sheet.

Compute: this is CPU/A100-light work; 32 GPUs on titan-a100 best-effort covers the CIFAR10 robustness reruns. No vulcan-h100 reservation needed, which keeps us out of Ines's queue.

One dependency: Evalline harness onboarding — Tomas's team says 2 weeks lead time, so Farah files the intake this week.

Daniela
